name: mla_prefill_varlen_prefix_n_heads12_qk_head_dim192_v_head_dim128
description: MLA's prefill attention once kv_b has expanded the latent keys, every head on its own: sequence s's queries are q's rows cu_seqlens_q[s]:cu_seqlens_q[s + 1], its keys and values the rows cu_seqlens_k[s]:cu_seqlens_k[s + 1] of k and v (with no prefix, the queries' own rows). Causal, aligned at the end: query i of a sequence of Lq queries over Lk keys reads keys 0 .. Lk - Lq + i. Logits q . k * sm_scale over qk_head_dim; output the softmax-weighted sum of v. With qkv_fp8 a kernel may round q, k and v to float8_e4m3fn first, as aiter's fp8 prefill does.

n_q.description: Query rows, every sequence's back to back.

n_kv.description: Key and value rows, every sequence's back to back.

n_heads.description: Heads on this rank; k and v carry q's.

qk_head_dim.description: Values per q and k head: the no-rope and rope parts.

v_head_dim.description: Values per v and output head.

cu_seqlens_q.description: Where each sequence's queries start in q, then where the last ends.

cu_seqlens_k.description: Where each sequence's keys start in k and v, then where the last ends.

output.description: The softmax-weighted sum of the values each query reads.

sources.content:
"""MLA prefill over a cached prefix, causal and end-aligned, in fp8: one FlyDSL launch casts q, k and v,
aiter's persistent ASM prefill runs on a causal work plan built once per shape, and a FlyDSL kernel merges
split query tiles' partials by log-sum-exp in a fixed order. Several sequences take one bf16 varlen call."""

import functools
import math

import flydsl.compiler as flyc
import flydsl.expr as fx
import torch
from flydsl.expr.typing import T

N_HEADS = 12
QK_DIM = 192
V_DIM = 128
TILE_Q = 256  # the plan's query tile

# --- FlyDSL map reduce. Each split tile s has a descriptor row [out_base, n_rows, n_splits, p_0 .. p_{MS-1}] with
# out_base = q_start * H, n_rows = (q_end - q_start) * H and p_j = partial row j * H (padded with p_0). Row x of the
# tile (x = local_q * H + h) merges partial rows p_j + x by their natural-log lse, in j order, into out_base + x.
_LOG2E = math.log2(math.e)
VEC = 4  # fp32 values per lane: one 16-byte load
LANES_PER_ROW = V_DIM // VEC
NUM_THREADS = 256
ROWS_PER_BLOCK = NUM_THREADS // LANES_PER_ROW
DESC_HEAD = 3


def _view(ptr, dtype, shape, stride):
    return fx.rocdl.make_buffer_tensor(
        fx.make_view(fx.recast_iter(dtype, ptr), fx.make_layout(shape, stride))
    )


@functools.cache
def compile_reduce(max_splits: int):
    MS = max_splits
    STRIDE = DESC_HEAD + MS

    @flyc.kernel(known_block_size=[NUM_THREADS, 1, 1])
    def reduce_kernel(
        part: fx.Pointer,  # f32 [P, V_DIM] (P = partial rows * H)
        lse: fx.Pointer,  # f32 [P]
        desc: fx.Pointer,  # i32 [n_tiles, STRIDE]
        out: fx.Pointer,  # bf16 [R, V_DIM]
        n_part: fx.Int32,
        n_out: fx.Int32,
        n_tiles: fx.Int32,
    ):
        tid = fx.thread_idx.x
        bx = fx.block_idx.x
        by = fx.block_idx.y
        c_lanes = fx.Int32(LANES_PER_ROW)
        x = bx * fx.Int32(ROWS_PER_BLOCK) + tid // c_lanes
        lane = tid % c_lanes

        g_desc = _view(desc, fx.Int32, (n_tiles * fx.Int32(STRIDE),), (1,))
        g_part = _view(part, fx.Float32, (n_part, V_DIM), (V_DIM, 1))
        g_lse = _view(lse, fx.Float32, (n_part,), (1,))
        g_out = _view(out, fx.BFloat16, (n_out, V_DIM), (V_DIM, 1))

        base = by * fx.Int32(STRIDE)
        out_base = g_desc[base]
        n_rows = g_desc[base + fx.Int32(1)]
        n_splits = g_desc[base + fx.Int32(2)]
        last = n_rows - fx.Int32(1)
        x = (x > last).select(last, x)

        reg_layout = fx.make_layout(VEC, 1)
        atom = fx.make_copy_atom(fx.rocdl.BufferCopy128b(), fx.Float32)
        neg_inf = fx.Float32(float("-inf"))

        lses = []
        parts = []
        for j in fx.range_constexpr(MS):
            prow = g_desc[base + fx.Int32(DESC_HEAD + j)] + x
            l = g_lse[prow]
            if j >= 2:
                l = (fx.Int32(j) < n_splits).select(l, neg_inf)
            lses.append(l)
            tiled = fx.logical_divide(fx.slice(g_part, (prow, None)), reg_layout)
            frag = fx.make_rmem_tensor(reg_layout, fx.Float32)
            fx.copy_atom_call(atom, fx.slice(tiled, (None, lane)), frag)
            parts.append(frag.load())

        m = lses[0]
        for j in fx.range_constexpr(1, MS):
            m = m.maximumf(lses[j])
        zero = fx.Float32(0.0)
        finite = m > neg_inf
        m = finite.select(m, zero)

        acc = [zero for _ in fx.range_constexpr(VEC)]
        den = zero
        for j in fx.range_constexpr(MS):
            w = fx.Float32(fx.rocdl.exp2(T.f32, ((lses[j] - m) * _LOG2E).ir_value()))
            den = den + w
            v = parts[j]
            acc = [acc[i] + w * v[i] for i in fx.range_constexpr(VEC)]
        inv = fx.Float32((den > zero).select(fx.rocdl.rcp(T.f32, den.ir_value()), zero))

        res = fx.make_rmem_tensor(reg_layout, fx.BFloat16)
        res.store(
            fx.Vector.from_elements(
                [(acc[i] * inv).to(fx.BFloat16) for i in fx.range_constexpr(VEC)], dtype=fx.BFloat16
            )
        )
        out_atom = fx.make_copy_atom(fx.rocdl.BufferCopy64b(), fx.BFloat16)
        out_tiled = fx.logical_divide(fx.slice(g_out, (out_base + x, None)), reg_layout)
        fx.copy_atom_call(out_atom, res, fx.slice(out_tiled, (None, lane)))

    @flyc.jit
    def launch(
        part: fx.Pointer,
        lse: fx.Pointer,
        desc: fx.Pointer,
        out: fx.Pointer,
        n_part: fx.Int32,
        n_out: fx.Int32,
        n_tiles: fx.Int32,
        n_blocks: fx.Int32,
        stream: fx.Stream = fx.Stream(None),  # noqa: B008
    ):
        reduce_kernel(part, lse, desc, out, n_part, n_out, n_tiles).launch(
            grid=(n_blocks, n_tiles, 1), block=(NUM_THREADS, 1, 1), stream=stream
        )

    return launch


# --- FlyDSL fused bf16 -> fp8 e4m3fn cast of q, k and v in one launch. Each tensor is a flat run of CAST_VEC-wide
# rows; block b owns unroll x CAST_THREADS consecutive rows of one tensor (q's blocks first, then k's, then v's), each
# lane one bf16 row load and one fp8 row store per step. The buffers' sizes bound the tails.
CAST_THREADS = 256
CAST_VEC = 8
CAST_UNROLL = 2  # rows per lane
# The bf16 inputs are read once, so they load nontemporal and leave the caches to the fp8 outputs the ASM reads
# next; nontemporal stores would speed the cast but slow the ASM by more, so the stores keep the default policy.
CAST_LOAD_POLICY = 2  # slc: nontemporal


def _flat_view(ptr, dtype, n_rows, width):
    t = fx.make_view(fx.recast_iter(dtype, ptr), fx.make_layout((n_rows, width), (width, 1)))
    return fx.rocdl.make_buffer_tensor(t, max_size=False)


@functools.cache
def compile_cast(unroll: int):
    rows_per_block = CAST_THREADS * unroll

    @flyc.kernel(known_block_size=[CAST_THREADS, 1, 1])
    def cast_kernel(
        q: fx.Pointer, k: fx.Pointer, v: fx.Pointer,  # bf16
        qo: fx.Pointer, ko: fx.Pointer, vo: fx.Pointer,  # fp8 bytes, as i32 pairs
        nq: fx.Int32, nk: fx.Int32, nv: fx.Int32,  # 8-element rows
        bq: fx.Int32, bk: fx.Int32,  # blocks of q, of q and k
    ):  # fmt: skip
        tid = fx.thread_idx.x
        bx = fx.block_idx.x
        reg_in = fx.make_layout(CAST_VEC, 1)
        reg_out = fx.make_layout(2, 1)
        atom_in = fx.make_copy_atom(fx.rocdl.BufferCopy128b(CAST_LOAD_POLICY), fx.BFloat16)
        atom_out = fx.make_copy_atom(fx.rocdl.BufferCopy64b(), fx.Int32)

        def body(src, dst, n, b):
            g_in = _flat_view(src, fx.BFloat16, n, CAST_VEC)
            g_out = _flat_view(dst, fx.Int32, n, 2)
            row0 = b * fx.Int32(rows_per_block) + tid
            vals = []
            for u in fx.range_constexpr(unroll):
                row = row0 + fx.Int32(u * CAST_THREADS)
                frag = fx.make_rmem_tensor(reg_in, fx.BFloat16)
                fx.copy_atom_call(atom_in, fx.slice(g_in, (row, None)), frag)
                vals.append(frag.load())
            for u in fx.range_constexpr(unroll):
                row = row0 + fx.Int32(u * CAST_THREADS)
                x = vals[u]
                f = [x[i].to(fx.Float32) for i in fx.range_constexpr(CAST_VEC)]
                words = []
                for w in fx.range_constexpr(2):
                    lo = fx.rocdl.cvt_pk_fp8_f32(
                        T.i32, f[4 * w].ir_value(), f[4 * w + 1].ir_value(), fx.Int32(0).ir_value(), False
                    )
                    hi = fx.rocdl.cvt_pk_fp8_f32(
                        T.i32, f[4 * w + 2].ir_value(), f[4 * w + 3].ir_value(), lo, True
                    )
                    words.append(fx.Int32(hi))
                res = fx.make_rmem_tensor(reg_out, fx.Int32)
                res.store(fx.Vector.from_elements(words, dtype=fx.Int32))
                fx.copy_atom_call(atom_out, res, fx.slice(g_out, (row, None)))

        if bx < bq:
            body(q, qo, nq, bx)
        elif bx < bk:
            body(k, ko, nk, bx - bq)
        else:
            body(v, vo, nv, bx - bk)

    @flyc.jit
    def launch(
        q: fx.Pointer, k: fx.Pointer, v: fx.Pointer,
        qo: fx.Pointer, ko: fx.Pointer, vo: fx.Pointer,
        nq: fx.Int32, nk: fx.Int32, nv: fx.Int32,
        bq: fx.Int32, bk: fx.Int32, n_blocks: fx.Int32,
        stream: fx.Stream = fx.Stream(None),  # noqa: B008
    ):  # fmt: skip
        assert unroll >= 1  # the unroll is a closure int the launcher reads, so it is part of the cache key
        cast_kernel(q, k, v, qo, ko, vo, nq, nk, nv, bq, bk).launch(
            grid=(n_blocks, 1, 1), block=(CAST_THREADS, 1, 1), stream=stream
        )

    return launch


def cast_fp8(q, k, v, qf, kf, vf, unroll: int):
    """q, k, v (contiguous bf16) -> qf, kf, vf (contiguous fp8 e4m3fn) in one launch."""
    nq, nk, nv = q.numel() // CAST_VEC, k.numel() // CAST_VEC, v.numel() // CAST_VEC
    rows = CAST_THREADS * unroll
    cb = lambda n: (n + rows - 1) // rows  # noqa: E731
    bq, bk, bv = cb(nq), cb(nk), cb(nv)
    compile_cast(unroll)(
        flyc.from_c_void_p(fx.BFloat16, q.data_ptr()),
        flyc.from_c_void_p(fx.BFloat16, k.data_ptr()),
        flyc.from_c_void_p(fx.BFloat16, v.data_ptr()),
        flyc.from_c_void_p(fx.Int32, qf.data_ptr()),
        flyc.from_c_void_p(fx.Int32, kf.data_ptr()),
        flyc.from_c_void_p(fx.Int32, vf.data_ptr()),
        nq, nk, nv, bq, bq + bk, bq + bk + bv,
        fx.Stream(torch.cuda.current_stream(q.device)),
    )  # fmt: skip


N_CU = 256
KV_BLOCK = 128


def _own_items(n_q: int, n_kv: int, chunks: int, c_item: int):
    """One head per CU list: each head's KV_BLOCK-key blocks, tile after tile, cut into `chunks` pieces at the same
    blocks for every head, balancing blocks + c_item per item. Returns per chunk a list of
    (tile, q_start, q_end, kv_start, kv_end, diag)."""
    prefix = n_kv - n_q
    n_tiles = (n_q + TILE_Q - 1) // TILE_Q
    tiles = []
    for t in range(n_tiles):
        qs, qe = t * TILE_Q, min(n_q, (t + 1) * TILE_Q)
        kv_end = min((prefix + qe + KV_BLOCK - 1) // KV_BLOCK * KV_BLOCK, n_kv)
        nb = (kv_end + KV_BLOCK - 1) // KV_BLOCK
        cut_max = (prefix + qs + 1) // KV_BLOCK  # every row sees all keys before a cut at block <= cut_max
        tiles.append((qs, qe, kv_end, nb, cut_max))

    def pack(m):
        out, cur, cost = [], [], 0
        t, b = 0, 0  # next block b of tile t
        while t < n_tiles:
            qs, qe, kv_end, nb, cut_max = tiles[t]
            room = m - cost - c_item
            rest = nb - b
            if rest <= room:
                cur.append((t, b, nb))
                cost += c_item + rest
                t, b = t + 1, 0
                continue
            e = min(b + max(room, 0), cut_max)
            if e > b:
                cur.append((t, b, e))
                b = e
            if not cur:
                return None
            out.append(cur)
            cur, cost = [], 0
        if cur:
            out.append(cur)
        return out

    lo, hi = 1, sum(tl[3] for tl in tiles) + c_item * (n_tiles + 1)
    while lo < hi:
        mid = (lo + hi) // 2
        r = pack(mid)
        if r is not None and len(r) <= chunks:
            hi = mid
        else:
            lo = mid + 1
    res = pack(lo)
    items = []
    for ch in res:
        its = []
        for t, b, e in ch:
            qs, qe, kv_end, nb, _ = tiles[t]
            ks = b * KV_BLOCK
            diag = e == nb
            ke = kv_end if diag else e * KV_BLOCK
            its.append((t, qs, qe, ks, ke, diag))
        items.append(its)
    return items


def _aligned_items(n_q: int, n_kv: int, chunks: int, c_item: int, spare: bool = False):
    """Like _own_items, but every tile is cut at the same R ranges of X blocks, list r * n_tiles + t holding range r of
    tile t so one range's lists read the same keys together; the diagonal remainders fill the other lists (with `spare`
    also one walking its cluster's heads, cost counted per head). Returns (max cost, items, heads per list) or None."""
    prefix = n_kv - n_q
    n_tiles = (n_q + TILE_Q - 1) // TILE_Q
    tiles = []
    for t in range(n_tiles):
        qs, qe = t * TILE_Q, min(n_q, (t + 1) * TILE_Q)
        kv_end = min((prefix + qe + KV_BLOCK - 1) // KV_BLOCK * KV_BLOCK, n_kv)
        nb = (kv_end + KV_BLOCK - 1) // KV_BLOCK
        cut_max = (prefix + qs + 1) // KV_BLOCK
        tiles.append((qs, qe, kv_end, nb, cut_max))
    cm = min(tl[4] for tl in tiles)

    def fill(R, X, m):
        """Tail lists under cost m: the L shortest tails whole, one per list (when there are more tails than lists),
        the others cut into the room left, every cut but the diagonal's at most cut_max."""
        L = chunks - R * n_tiles
        order = sorted(range(n_tiles), key=lambda t: tiles[t][3])
        whole, rest = order[:L], order[L:]
        lists = [[tiles[t][3] - R * X + c_item, [(t, R * X, tiles[t][3])], 1] for t in whole]
        if spare:
            lists.append([0, [], 3])
        if any(c > m for c, _, _ in lists):
            return None
        for t in reversed(rest):
            b, nb, cut = R * X, tiles[t][3], tiles[t][4]
            for ls in sorted(lists, key=lambda ls: ls[0] - m // ls[2]):
                room = m // ls[2] - ls[0] - c_item
                if room <= 0:
                    continue
                if nb - b <= room:
                    ls[1].append((t, b, nb))
                    ls[0] += nb - b + c_item
                    b = nb
                    break
                e = min(b + room, cut)
                if e > b:
                    ls[1].append((t, b, e))
                    ls[0] += e - b + c_item
                    b = e
            if b < nb:
                return None
        return lists

    best = None
    for R in range(1, (chunks - 1) // n_tiles + 1):
        L = chunks - R * n_tiles
        if L < 1:
            break
        for X in range(1, cm // R + 1):
            tails = sorted(((tiles[t][3] - R * X, t) for t in range(n_tiles)), reverse=True)
            if n_tiles <= L:
                bins = [[0, []] for _ in range(L)]
                for nbk, t in tails:  # longest tail first into the lightest list
                    b = min(bins, key=lambda bn: bn[0])
                    b[0] += nbk + c_item
                    b[1].append((t, R * X, tiles[t][3]))
                bins = [[bn[0], sorted(bn[1]), 1] for bn in bins if bn[1]]
            else:
                # the tails' total over the L lists bounds the cost from below; a cost above the best so far loses
                tot = sum(nbk + c_item for nbk, _ in tails)
                m = max(X + c_item, (3 * tot + 3 * L) // (3 * L + 1) if spare else (tot + L - 1) // L)
                cap = 4 * (X + c_item) + sum(tl[3] for tl in tiles)
                if best is not None:
                    cap = min(cap, best[0][0] + 1)
                while (bins := fill(R, X, m)) is None and m < cap:
                    m += 1
                if bins is None:
                    continue
                bins = [bn for bn in bins if bn[1]]
            cost = max(X + c_item, max(bn[0] * bn[2] for bn in bins))
            splits = max(R + sum(1 for bn in bins for it in bn[1] if it[0] == t) for t in range(n_tiles))
            key = (cost, splits, -R * X)
            if best is None or key < best[0]:
                best = (key, R, X, [bn[1] for bn in bins], [bn[2] for bn in bins])
    if best is None:
        return None
    (cost, _, _), R, X, tail_lists, tail_hpl = best
    items = []
    for r in range(R):
        for t in range(n_tiles):
            qs, qe, kv_end, nb, cut_max = tiles[t]
            assert (r + 1) * X <= cut_max
            items.append([(t, qs, qe, r * X * KV_BLOCK, (r + 1) * X * KV_BLOCK, False)])
    for its in tail_lists:
        lst = []
        for t, b, e in its:
            qs, qe, kv_end, nb, cut_max = tiles[t]
            diag = e == nb
            assert diag or e <= cut_max
            lst.append((t, qs, qe, b * KV_BLOCK, kv_end if diag else e * KV_BLOCK, diag))
        items.append(lst)
    hpl = [1] * (R * n_tiles) + tail_hpl
    assert len(items) - (3 in hpl) <= chunks and hpl.count(3) <= 1
    for t in range(n_tiles):  # every block of every tile exactly once, one diagonal piece per tile
        cov = sorted((ks, ke) for its in items for (tt, _, _, ks, ke, _) in its if tt == t)
        assert cov[0][0] == 0 and cov[-1][1] == tiles[t][2]
        assert all(a[1] == b[0] for a, b in zip(cov, cov[1:]))
        assert sum(1 for its in items for it in its if it[0] == t and it[5]) == 1
    return cost, items, hpl


def _items_cost(items, c_item):
    return max(
        sum((ke - ks + KV_BLOCK - 1) // KV_BLOCK + c_item for (_, _, _, ks, ke, _) in its) for its in items
    )


def _place(n_q: int, n_kv: int, items, hpl, device):
    """work_indptr / work_info and the reduce's descriptors. Chunk k (its pieces items[k]) runs on 3 CU lists of each
    cluster, one per head, when hpl[k] == 1, or on one list walking the cluster's 3 heads per piece when hpl[k] == 3.
    Cluster c's lists take the workgroups w with w % 8 in {2c, 2c + 1}: one XCD pair on any stream."""
    # which chunks cover each tile, in line order
    per_tile = {}
    for k, its in enumerate(items):
        for it in its:
            per_tile.setdefault(it[0], []).append(k)
    slot_of = {}
    n_slots = 0
    desc_tiles = []
    for t in sorted(per_tile):
        ks = per_tile[t]
        if len(ks) > 1:
            for j, k in enumerate(ks):
                slot_of[(t, k)] = n_slots
                n_slots += 1
            desc_tiles.append((t, [slot_of[(t, k)] for k in ks]))
    lists = [[] for _ in range(N_CU)]
    n_clusters = N_HEADS // 3
    xcd_per_cluster = 8 // n_clusters
    for cl in range(n_clusters):
        wgs = [
            x + 8 * i
            for x in range(cl * xcd_per_cluster, (cl + 1) * xcd_per_cluster)
            for i in range(N_CU // 8)
        ]
        pos = 0
        for k, its in enumerate(items):
            groups = (
                [[h] for h in range(3 * cl, 3 * cl + 3)] if hpl[k] == 1 else [list(range(3 * cl, 3 * cl + 3))]
            )
            for hs in groups:
                w = wgs[pos]
                pos += 1
                for h, (t, qs, qe, ks, ke, diag) in [(h, it) for it in its for h in hs]:
                    ploc = slot_of[(t, k)] * TILE_Q if (t, k) in slot_of else -1
                    koff = 0 if diag else n_kv - ke
                    lists[w].append([0, ploc, qs, qe, ks, ke, koff, ((h + 1) << 16) | h])
    indptr = [0]
    info = []
    for lst in lists:
        info += lst
        indptr.append(len(info))
    max_splits = max((len(s) for _, s in desc_tiles), default=0)
    desc = []
    for t, slots in desc_tiles:
        qs, qe = t * TILE_Q, min(n_q, (t + 1) * TILE_Q)
        ps = [s * TILE_Q * N_HEADS for s in slots]
        ps += [ps[0]] * (max_splits - len(ps))
        desc += [qs * N_HEADS, (qe - qs) * N_HEADS, len(slots)] + ps
    work_indptr = torch.tensor(indptr, dtype=torch.int32, device=device)
    work_info = torch.tensor(info, dtype=torch.int32, device=device).view(-1)
    desc_t = torch.tensor(desc or [0], dtype=torch.int32, device=device)
    indices = torch.arange(n_kv, dtype=torch.int32, device=device)
    one = torch.ones((), dtype=torch.float32, device=device)
    n_partial = max(n_slots, 1) * TILE_Q
    launch = compile_reduce(max_splits) if desc_tiles else None
    return work_indptr, work_info, indices, one, n_partial, desc_t, len(desc_tiles), launch


def _d1a(work_indptr, work_info):
    """Permute aiter's whole CU lists so each 3-head cluster sits on two XCDs (WGs equal mod 8 share an XCD)."""
    wi = work_indptr.cpu().tolist()
    info = work_info.cpu().view(-1, 8).tolist()
    n = len(wi) - 1
    clusters = {}
    for l in range(n):
        cs = {(info[w][7] & 0xFFFF) // 3 for w in range(wi[l], wi[l + 1])}
        if len(cs) != 1:
            return work_indptr, work_info
        clusters.setdefault(cs.pop(), []).append(l)
    if n != N_CU or len(clusters) != 4 or any(len(v) != 64 for v in clusters.values()):
        return work_indptr, work_info
    new = [None] * n
    for c, ls in clusters.items():
        for i, l in enumerate(ls):
            new[(i // 2) * 8 + 2 * c + (i % 2)] = info[wi[l] : wi[l + 1]]
    indptr, flat = [0], []
    for lst in new:
        for it in lst:
            flat += it
        indptr.append(indptr[-1] + len(lst))
    rest = work_info.cpu().view(-1)[len(flat) :].tolist()
    dev = work_info.device
    return (
        torch.tensor(indptr, dtype=torch.int32, device=dev),
        torch.tensor(flat + rest, dtype=torch.int32, device=dev).view(work_info.shape),
    )


@functools.cache
def _fp8_plan(n_q: int, n_kv: int, device, permute: bool = True):
    """aiter's causal persistent plan for one sequence of n_q queries over n_kv keys, and the reduce's descriptors.

    The planner writes its buffers with a synchronous hipMemcpy on the null stream, which does not order with the
    current stream: into device memory just freed it races with writes still queued there. So it plans on the host
    and the CU lists go to the device with .to(), in stream order."""
    from aiter import get_ps_metadata_info_v1, get_ps_metadata_v1

    qo_cpu = torch.tensor([0, n_q], dtype=torch.int32)
    kv_cpu = torch.tensor([0, n_kv], dtype=torch.int32)
    sizes = get_ps_metadata_info_v1(batch_size=1, num_head_k=N_HEADS, max_qlen=n_q, qlen_granularity=TILE_Q)
    buffers = [torch.zeros(size, dtype=dtype) for size, dtype in sizes]
    work_metadata, work_indptr, work_info, reduce_indptr, reduce_final_map, reduce_partial_map = buffers
    get_ps_metadata_v1(
        qo_cpu, kv_cpu, kv_cpu.diff(), 1, N_HEADS,
        work_metadata, work_indptr, work_info, reduce_indptr, reduce_final_map, reduce_partial_map,
        qhead_granularity=1, qlen_granularity=TILE_Q, kvlen_granularity=128, block_size=1, is_causal=True,
    )  # fmt: skip
    if permute:
        work_indptr, work_info = _d1a(work_indptr, work_info)
    work_indptr, work_info = work_indptr.to(device), work_info.to(device)
    indptr = reduce_indptr.cpu().tolist()
    final = reduce_final_map.cpu().view(-1, 2).tolist()
    partial = reduce_partial_map.cpu().tolist()
    tiles = [(t, indptr[t], indptr[t + 1]) for t in range(len(indptr) - 1) if indptr[t + 1] - indptr[t] > 1]
    max_splits = max((b - a for _, a, b in tiles), default=0)
    rows = [partial[j] for _, a, b in tiles for j in range(a, b)]
    n_partial = (max(rows) + TILE_Q) if rows else TILE_Q
    desc = []
    for t, a, b in tiles:
        q_start, q_end = final[t]
        ps = [partial[j] * N_HEADS for j in range(a, b)]
        ps += [ps[0]] * (max_splits - len(ps))
        desc += [q_start * N_HEADS, (q_end - q_start) * N_HEADS, b - a] + ps
    desc_t = torch.tensor(desc or [0], dtype=torch.int32, device=device)
    indices = torch.arange(n_kv, dtype=torch.int32, device=device)
    one = torch.ones((), dtype=torch.float32, device=device)
    launch = compile_reduce(max_splits) if tiles else None
    return work_indptr, work_info, indices, one, n_partial, desc_t, len(tiles), launch


OWN_PLAN_CHUNKS = 21  # one list per head and chunk nearly fills the CUs, each cluster's lists on one XCD pair
# Sequences of fewer query tiles than OWN_PLAN_CHUNKS take the one-head key-aligned plan, with its spare 3-head list,
# when its longest list is no longer than the unaligned one-head plan's; ALIGNED1_C_ITEM is the per-item cost of both.
ALIGNED1_C_ITEM = 6
# The others of fewer query tiles than a cluster has CU lists take a key-aligned plan whose every list walks its
# cluster's 3 heads (one-head lists lose clock there), when its longest list is within ALIGNED3_SLACK blocks of
# aiter's; ALIGNED3_C_ITEM is the per-item cost its lists are balanced on.
ALIGNED3_MAX_TILES = 64
ALIGNED3_C_ITEM = 6
ALIGNED3_SLACK = 6


@functools.cache
def _plan(n_q: int, n_kv: int, device):
    n_tiles = (n_q + TILE_Q - 1) // TILE_Q
    if n_tiles <= OWN_PLAN_CHUNKS - 1:
        al = _aligned_items(n_q, n_kv, OWN_PLAN_CHUNKS, ALIGNED1_C_ITEM, spare=True)
        own = _own_items(n_q, n_kv, OWN_PLAN_CHUNKS, ALIGNED1_C_ITEM)
        if al is not None and al[0] <= _items_cost(own, ALIGNED1_C_ITEM):
            return _place(n_q, n_kv, al[1], al[2], device)
    if n_tiles < ALIGNED3_MAX_TILES:
        al = _aligned_items(n_q, n_kv, N_CU // 4, ALIGNED3_C_ITEM)
        if al is not None:
            wi, info = _fp8_plan(n_q, n_kv, device)[:2]
            wi, info = wi.cpu().tolist(), info.cpu().view(-1, 8).tolist()
            aiter_cost = (
                max(
                    sum((it[5] - it[4] + KV_BLOCK - 1) // KV_BLOCK for it in info[wi[l] : wi[l + 1]])
                    for l in range(len(wi) - 1)
                )
                // 3
            )
            if _items_cost(al[1], 0) <= aiter_cost + ALIGNED3_SLACK:
                return _place(n_q, n_kv, al[1], [3] * len(al[1]), device)
    return _fp8_plan(n_q, n_kv, device)


def run(*, q, k, v, cu_seqlens_q, qkv_fp8, cu_seqlens_k, sm_scale, output):
    offsets_k = cu_seqlens_q if cu_seqlens_k is None else cu_seqlens_k
    n_q, n_kv = q.shape[0], k.shape[0]
    if cu_seqlens_q.shape[0] != 2:
        from aiter import flash_attn_varlen_func

        # the row counts bound the longest sequence's without reading the offsets
        flash_attn_varlen_func(
            q, k, v, cu_seqlens_q, offsets_k, n_q, n_kv, softmax_scale=sm_scale, causal=True, out=output
        )
        return

    from aiter import mla_prefill_ps_asm_fwd

    work_indptr, work_info, indices, one, n_partial, desc, n_tiles, launch = _plan(n_q, n_kv, q.device)
    fp8 = torch.float8_e4m3fn
    if q.is_contiguous() and k.is_contiguous() and v.is_contiguous():
        nq, nk = q.numel(), k.numel()
        buf = torch.empty(nq + nk + v.numel(), dtype=fp8, device=q.device)
        qf, kf, vf = buf[:nq].view(q.shape), buf[nq : nq + nk].view(k.shape), buf[nq + nk :].view(v.shape)
        cast_fp8(q, k, v, qf, kf, vf, CAST_UNROLL)
    else:
        qf, kf, vf = q.to(fp8), k.to(fp8), v.to(fp8)
    logits = torch.empty((n_partial, N_HEADS, V_DIM), dtype=torch.float32, device=q.device)
    lse = torch.empty((n_partial, N_HEADS), dtype=torch.float32, device=q.device)
    mla_prefill_ps_asm_fwd(
        qf, kf, vf, cu_seqlens_q, offsets_k, indices, work_indptr, work_info, n_q, sm_scale, True,
        logits, lse, output, one, one, one,
    )  # fmt: skip
    if n_tiles:
        n_rows = n_partial * N_HEADS
        launch(
            flyc.from_c_void_p(fx.Float32, logits.data_ptr()),
            flyc.from_c_void_p(fx.Float32, lse.data_ptr()),
            flyc.from_c_void_p(fx.Int32, desc.data_ptr()),
            flyc.from_c_void_p(fx.BFloat16, output.data_ptr()),
            n_rows,
            n_q * N_HEADS,
            n_tiles,
            (TILE_Q * N_HEADS) // ROWS_PER_BLOCK,
            fx.Stream(torch.cuda.current_stream(output.device)),
        )
